package.name: yobotics_description
package.description: Mesh-only package providing the visual STL files referenced by the Yobotics/mini-cheetah URDF (package://yobotics_description/meshes/*). These are decimated versions (~2-6k triangles/part, down from the original 20k-213k/part) of the meshes from github.com/HitSZwang/mini-cheetah-gazebo-urdf - full detail wasn't usable under software rendering (LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE), so triangle count was reduced via quadric decimation while keeping recognizable part shapes.
